services.trigger: User taps play on a sound preview in Sounds tab or Sound Detail
services.notification: Media-style playback controls with title and progress
services.stopCondition: Playback ends, user pauses, or task removed while not playing
services.whyNotDeferred: Audio preview must keep the ExoPlayer decoder alive while the user browses; WorkManager cannot provide sub-second playback continuity
services.interruptionImpact: Sound preview stops immediately; no data loss
services.notificationDeniedBehavior: Playback still works but no visible notification controls; user must return to Aura to pause
demoVideoSteps: Tap any sound card to start playback
Show notification shade with playback controls
Background the app; playback continues with controls
Tap pause in notification; playback stops
Remove app from recents; service stops

services.trigger: User enables 'Change on every unlock' or 'Pre-stage on screen off' in Settings
services.notification: Low-priority ongoing notification: 'Aura — wallpaper triggers / Rotating on unlock / screen off'
services.stopCondition: User disables both trigger toggles in Settings
services.whyNotDeferred: ACTION_USER_PRESENT and ACTION_SCREEN_OFF cannot be manifest-declared on Android 8+; a foreground service with dynamic BroadcastReceiver is the only way to catch these system events reliably
services.interruptionImpact: Wallpaper rotation stops firing on unlock/screen-off; scheduled periodic rotation (AutoWallpaperWorker) continues independently
services.notificationDeniedBehavior: Service runs without a visible notification on Android 13+; triggers still fire but the user cannot see the ongoing indicator
services.bootBehavior: Triggers resume after the user opens Aura (FreeVibeApp.reconcileRotationTriggers on cold start); they do not auto-start on boot
demoVideoSteps: Open Aura > Settings > Auto wallpaper rotation section
Show notification shade with ongoing trigger notification
Lock and unlock the device; wallpaper changes
Disable the toggle; notification disappears and service stops
